focus: frame-preposition: verb + à / de + infinitive, where French does not use the English preposition (conseiller / interdire / reprocher à qqn de, arrêter de, passer du temps à, au lieu de, plutôt que de, arriver à, avoir peur de)
calque: a real French word with the wrong meaning, or English word order carried over (dépenser for time, gentilement for gently, d'ailleurs for otherwise, pas important for never mind)
negation: ne ... jamais / pas encore / toujours pas, the slot around the auxiliary, ne in front of a negated infinitive, un becoming de
agreement: silent endings such as tu arrêtes, la plus chère, mes parents, the participle after a preceding direct object
tense: the futur after quand / dès que, imparfait against passé composé, si + plus-que-parfait
pronoun: direct against indirect object (lui / l'), dont, y and en

scenarios.title: Au restaurant
scenarios.setting: A small restaurant, a busy evening. You are with one other person and one of you is a bit fussy.
scenarios.goal: Order a meal, ask about the dishes, and deal with something that is not quite right.
scenarios.opener: Bonsoir, bienvenue. Vous avez choisi, ou je vous laisse encore un moment ?

scenarios.title: À la pharmacie
scenarios.blurb: Describe symptoms, understand the advice, ask how to take it.
scenarios.setting: You have a sore throat and a headache since yesterday. You go into a pharmacy. Use vous with the pharmacist.
scenarios.goal: Say what is wrong and for how long, understand what to take and when, and ask one question about it.
targets: il faut / je vous conseille de

scenarios.title: Chez le médecin
scenarios.blurb: A check-up that turns into a lecture. Advice, bans and promises.
scenarios.setting: You are at a routine appointment. You have been tired, you smoke, and you do not sleep well.
scenarios.ai: a frank, kind doctor in a city surgery
scenarios.goal: Explain how you feel, understand the advice, and say what you will actually do.
scenarios.opener: Bonjour, installez-vous. Alors, qu'est-ce qui vous amène aujourd'hui ?

scenarios.title: Le nouvel appartement
scenarios.blurb: Telling a friend about a flat hunt, and an old friend who found one.
scenarios.setting: You meet a friend for coffee. You are moving next year and have not told your parents yet.
scenarios.ai: a chatty friend of yours, a little nosy
scenarios.goal: Talk about the move, who you have told, and what the new place is like compared with the old one.
scenarios.opener: Alors, c'est vrai que tu penses déménager ? Raconte !

scenarios.title: Le train en retard
scenarios.blurb: A cancelled train, a missed meeting, and who is to blame.
scenarios.setting: You are on a platform. Your train is delayed again and you have a meeting in an hour.
scenarios.ai: a station employee at the information desk
scenarios.you: a traveller who is trying to stay polite
scenarios.goal: Find out what happened, what your options are, and get on another train.
scenarios.opener: Bonjour monsieur, madame. Je vous écoute, vous avez un problème avec votre train ?

scenarios.title: Le voisin bruyant
scenarios.blurb: A polite complaint that has to stay polite.
scenarios.setting: You knock on your neighbour's door at 11 p.m. The music has been loud for three nights.
scenarios.ai: a neighbour, a bit defensive at first, who can be talked round
scenarios.goal: Explain the problem, ask them to stop, and agree on something.
scenarios.opener: Oui ? Ah, c'est vous. Il y a un problème ?

scenarios.title: Le week-end dernier
scenarios.blurb: Telling a story in the past. Background against events.
scenarios.setting: Monday morning at work. A colleague asks what you did.
scenarios.goal: Tell what happened at the weekend, in order, with what was going on around it.
scenarios.opener: Salut ! Alors, c'était comment, ton week-end ? Tu as fait quelque chose de sympa ?

scenarios.title: Un problème à l'hôtel
scenarios.blurb: A room that is not what you booked, and a polite way to fix it.
scenarios.setting: You arrive late at a hotel. The room is on the street side and you booked a quiet one at the back. Use vous.
scenarios.ai: the receptionist, courteous but short of free rooms
scenarios.goal: Explain the problem, say what you booked, and agree on a solution.
scenarios.opener: Bonsoir, bienvenue à l'hôtel des Tilleuls. Vous avez une réservation ?

scenarios.title: Chez le garagiste
scenarios.blurb: A car that will not start, and a bill you did not expect.
scenarios.setting: Your car broke down on the way back from a trip. You bring it in and ask when it will be ready. Use vous.
scenarios.ai: a garage mechanic, direct, a little brusque
scenarios.goal: Say what happened, understand the diagnosis, and agree on the price and the date.
scenarios.opener: Bonjour. Alors, c'est la voiture qui fait des siennes ? Racontez-moi ce qui s'est passé.

scenarios.title: Une soirée entre amis
scenarios.setting: You are organising a dinner at your place on Saturday and calling a friend to settle it. Use tu.
scenarios.ai: a close friend who is always late and always cheerful
scenarios.goal: Invite them, agree on a time, and sort out who brings what.
scenarios.opener: Allô ? Oui, salut ! Alors, tu m'appelles pour quoi ? Dis-moi tout.

scenarios.title: Planifier les vacances
scenarios.blurb: Two people who want different holidays.
scenarios.setting: You and a friend are deciding where to go this summer. You want a quiet place, they want a city. Use tu.
scenarios.ai: a friend who wants an energetic city break
scenarios.you: the one who wants to rest
scenarios.goal: Say what you prefer and why, propose a compromise, and decide on a place.
scenarios.opener: Alors, cet été, on part où ? Moi, j'ai trouvé un week-end à Barcelone, ça te dit ?

scenarios.title: Visiter un appartement
scenarios.setting: You are viewing a flat for rent. It is smaller than the photos, but bright. You have a budget. Use vous.
scenarios.ai: a letting agent who stresses the good points
scenarios.goal: Ask about size, rent and charges, say what bothers you, and say whether you would take it.
scenarios.opener: Bonjour, entrez, je vous en prie. Voici le séjour, vous voyez comme il est lumineux ?

scenarios.title: Parler d'un film
scenarios.setting: You have just seen a film that a friend recommended. You are telling them what you thought. Use tu.
scenarios.ai: a friend who loves films and has strong opinions
scenarios.you: someone who saw it and has mixed feelings
scenarios.goal: Say what you liked and did not, compare it with something else, and say who should see it.
targets: superlatives and le meilleur que j'aie vu
je trouve que / je ne pense pas que
scenarios.opener: Alors ? Tu l'as vu, finalement ? Ne me dis pas que tu t'es endormi !

scenarios.title: Souvenirs d'enfance
scenarios.blurb: What life used to be like. The imparfait, all of it.
scenarios.setting: You are at a family dinner and an older relative asks what your childhood was like. Use tu.
scenarios.ai: a curious grandparent who loves stories
scenarios.goal: Describe where you lived, what you did every summer, and one particular day that went wrong.
scenarios.opener: Raconte-moi un peu, comment c'était quand tu étais petit ? Tu habitais où ?

scenarios.title: Un entretien d'embauche
scenarios.blurb: Answer questions about your past and your plans, and ask some back.
scenarios.setting: A job interview for a role you would really like. The interviewer is friendly but exact.
scenarios.goal: Present your experience, explain a gap or a change, and say where you want to be in five years.
scenarios.opener: Bonjour, merci d'être venu. Pour commencer, pouvez-vous vous présenter en quelques mots ?

scenarios.title: Un souci au travail
scenarios.blurb: A colleague who keeps dropping the ball.
scenarios.setting: A project has slipped because a colleague missed three deadlines. You ask to talk, calmly. Use vous.
scenarios.ai: a colleague, a bit defensive, who does have reasons
scenarios.you: the colleague who has been affected
scenarios.goal: Say what went wrong without attacking, hear their side, and agree on what changes.
scenarios.opener: Tu voulais me voir ? Je n'ai que dix minutes, j'ai une réunion après.

scenarios.title: Un vol au commissariat
scenarios.blurb: Report a stolen bag. Tell it in order, precisely.
scenarios.setting: Your bag was stolen on a train this afternoon. You are at the police station to report it. Use vous.
scenarios.ai: a police officer taking a statement, patient and methodical
scenarios.goal: Say what happened, in order, what was in the bag, and what you noticed before and after.
scenarios.opener: Bonjour, asseyez-vous. Je vais prendre votre déposition. Qu'est-ce qui s'est passé, exactement ?

scenarios.title: Appeler le service client
scenarios.blurb: A wrong bill, a long hold, a firm but polite complaint.
scenarios.setting: Your internet has been down for four days and you are still being billed. You phone customer service. Use vous.
scenarios.ai: a customer service agent who follows a script and can be moved by clear facts
scenarios.goal: Explain the problem and how long it has lasted, say what you expect, and get a concrete commitment.
targets: depuis / il y a / ça fait
scenarios.opener: Service client, bonjour, vous êtes bien chez Optilink. Je m'appelle Karim, comment puis-je vous aider ?

scenarios.title: Free conversation
scenarios.blurb: Pick your own topic. The model follows you.
scenarios.setting: Whatever you want. Say what you would like to talk about in your first message, in French or in English.
scenarios.ai: a friendly French speaker of your age who is curious about you
scenarios.opener: Salut ! De quoi as-tu envie de parler aujourd'hui ?
